runs.t: 100+ standard colors, textures, and finish combinations — plus virtually unlimited custom options. Every facade tells a different story.
Varying levels of sandblasting treatment expose aggregate and create textural depth — from a light brushed surface to a heavy rough texture.
Specific aggregate types, sizes, and colors exposed through acid wash or sandblasting — creating a natural stone-like appearance.
Custom-designed liners pressed into fresh concrete create intricate surface patterns, geometric designs, and linear reveals.
Real brick, terra cotta, or ceramic tile cast directly into the concrete veneer — achieving masonry aesthetics without masonry trade coordination.
Natural stone, tile, and other decorative materials cast or adhered into the panel surface at the factory for a premium finished appearance.
Integrated metal panel systems combined with precast or GFRC for contemporary mixed-material facades. Factory-installed for precision alignment.
Beyond the colors and textures shown, materials like brick, terracotta, and stone can be cast into the exterior veneer. Form liners allow endless geometric patterns and reveals.

Custom-made forms create concrete panels in precise dimensions and shapes. Varying sands, aggregates, and pigments achieve specific color effects. Stone, tile, or brick veneers can be cast into panels at the plant.
Brick, terra cotta, and stone cast into the veneer
Form liners for unlimited geometric patterns and reveals
Sandblast levels from light to heavy texture
Stain and pigment applications for custom color matching
The complete catalog of standard colors, forms, textures, and finish combinations for our integrated envelope systems — with specification notes for each.
